name: Trekktraseen Opp
description: Trekktraseen Up is a mountain race organized by Jølster Sports Club. The race takes place in Bjørkelia and has attracted many participants. It is known for its challenging uphill route, which offers participants a fantastic view of the area.
course_highlights: Sindre Hoff and Karoline Holsen Kyte both set new personal bests in their category on the challenging course in Jølster.
Sindre Hoff broke Bjarne Ness's old record of 6.33 by two seconds.
Karoline Holsen Kyte erased Ingrid Narum's nearly ten-year-old record when she reached the top at 8.24.

images.alt_text: Running uphill with a fantastic view of mountains and water.
Runner in the Trek Trail Up. A man is running up a mountainside with an audience in the background.
Runner uphill, The Pull Route Up.
Start sign for the race with a map of the course.

name: Veten Opp - Sea to Summit
description: The Veten Opp - Sea to Summit race starts at the quay area in Finneidfjord and ascends to the TV antenna at the top of Mount Veten. The distance is 5 km with an elevation gain of 700 meters. The first part of the race follows a road, before continuing up a forest road and trail through forest and mountain terrain.
course_highlights: The race has a distance of 5 km with an elevation gain of 700 meters.
The first part of the race goes along the road.
The race continues uphill along a forest road and trail through woodland and mountainous terrain.

images.alt_text: View from the mountain Veten with power lines and antenna, possibly the finish line of the course.
Logo for Veten Opp - Sea to Summit. Blue mountain motif with the text "Veten Opp" and "Sea to Summit".
Map of Veten Opp uphill race, with route up the mountain.
Route map for the Veten Opp race, showing the course up the mountain.

name: Torvikbukt 6 Topper
description: Torvikbukt 6 Peaks is a fantastic round trip around the mountain peaks surrounding the village. Thanks to the annual event that takes place in September, there is a good path along large parts of the route. The hike can be completed in its entirety, covering nearly 2000 meters of elevation gain and 22 km in length, but it can also be divided, for example, about halfway when crossing the county road in Torvikdalen. Torvikbukt Sports Club invites you to the 21st edition of Torvikbukt 6 Peaks on Saturday, September 14, 2024.
course_highlights: Great round trip on the mountain peaks around the village.
Good trail along large parts of the route.
The route can be divided at the county road in Torvikdalen.

images.alt_text: Runners in beautiful terrain during the Torvikbukt 6 Peaks.
Runners in challenging terrain during Torvikbukt 6 Peaks.
Runners are approaching the finish line in a trail race. Great atmosphere!
Runners in beautiful terrain during the Torvikbukt 6 Peaks.

name: Resfjellet Opp
description: Resfjellet Up is a mountain running race held in Meldal, Orkland municipality, and takes place for the second time on Saturday, September 10. The race features a competitive course of approximately 10 km, with 1000 meters of elevation gain from start to finish, and also offers fitness classes at 10 km and 6 km, as well as a children's race called Resfjellet Up Mini. The organizers promise that the competitive course is among the toughest mountain races in Trøndelag, and there are prizes for both course records and sprint prizes.
course_highlights: The competition class has timing and is divided into Women and Men, with junior and senior categories.
Many great raffle prizes are awarded to the participants, sponsored by the local business community.
The family event at Gammelsetervollan includes grilling, food sales, and activities for children, as well as a nature trail.

images.alt_text: Children on the podium after Resfjellet up Mini.
Children are running in a race, probably Resfjellet Up Mini.
Children's race on a grass track with obstacles. Two boys are running.
Logo for Resfjellet uphill race in Meldal, Orkland.

name: Nærsnes Backyard Run
description: Nærsnes Backyard is not about being first, but is a social low-threshold race held in Nærsnes. We have a great children's course and a larger adult course that caters to those who have never run before, to those who have run a little, to active runners. In the children's race, participation is the focus, and the event aims to be climate neutral and to serve as a pioneering race in terms of inclusion.
course_highlights: The event features a children's course and an adult course tailored to all levels, from beginners to active runners.
Participation is the focus in the children's race, promoting an inclusive atmosphere.
The race is designed to be climate neutral, with the aim of setting the standard for inclusion in running events.

images.alt_text: Runner in Nærsnes Backyard Run. Beautiful nature in the background.
Runners in a race at Nærsnes.
Runner on the track during the Nærsnes Backyard Run.
Children are running in the Nærsnes Backyard Run.

name: Gjørmelabben Romerike
description: The Mud Paw is an unforgettable obstacle course for everyone with a dog, where all are welcome! The event is suitable for both individual teams, children with companions, and groups of friends and family. It’s a guarantee for fun in the mud! 😃🐶
course_highlights: Gjørmelabben - an unforgettable event for both individual participants, children with companions, or in teams together with friends and/or family.
Obstacle course for everyone with a dog, all are welcome!
Mud guarantee 😃🐶

images.alt_text: Half dog, half wolf.
Dog racing with people and dogs on a road.
Running in the woods with a headlamp.

name: Grenland Hinderløp
description: Grenland obstacle course gives you the chance to be challenged in new ways and have fun navigating the course at Jarseng. You can look forward to crawling under and over obstacles, balancing, carrying, and rolling in the mud. The level of the course is designed so that everyone can get through, but if an obstacle proves too difficult, you have the option to complete a different task instead. You can choose to participate individually or as part of a team of 3-5 people, and together as a team, you help each other through the obstacles.
course_highlights: You can look forward to crawling under and over obstacles, balancing, carrying, and rolling in the mud.
The level of the course should be such that everyone can get through, but if an obstacle becomes too difficult, you will have the opportunity to do a different task instead.
How about using the obstacle course as a team-building activity at work or to do something fun with your group of friends?

name: Nordfjordryggen Fjelløp
description: The support that Trivselsskogen has received will be used to organize a mountain race over the Nordfjord Ridge from Utvikfjellet to TIN-camp. The Nordfjord Ridge Mountain Race is an event for anyone who wants to walk or run the Nordfjord Ridge and is expected to conclude the activity festival.
course_highlights: The race goes from Utvikfjellet to TIN camp.
The Nordfjordryggen Mountain Run is open to everyone who wishes to participate, either by walking or running.
The race is expected to conclude the activity festival.

images.alt_text: View over the fjord and the mountains. A beautiful landscape for a mountain race.
Runner in mountain terrain with number 16, ready for the Nordfjordryggen Mountain Race.
Snow-covered mountains with a lake in Nordfjord. Ski poles and skis in the foreground.
Snow-covered mountain landscape with a lake and skiing, beautiful view over Nordfjord.

name: Magni Maraton 102
description: Magni Marathon is a Cannonball-type race, where participants essentially take care of themselves. The race was first held on January 10, 2015, and takes place approximately once a month. For a full marathon, we run 8 laps on a course with the start and finish at Stavset. Participants take their own time and record it in the runner's book upon finishing. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and an electronic diploma.
course_highlights: The course takes you through beautiful landscapes, with varied terrain and picturesque surroundings.
Participants can expect a challenging yet rewarding course that provides a sense of achievement upon crossing the finish line.
Everyone who finishes will receive a medal and an electronic diploma.

images.alt_text: Runner in Magni Marathon gives a thumbs up.
Three gold trophies with green details and a black base, likely for a competition.
Building with Stavset School, start and finish for Magni Marathon.

name: Kystjegerløpet
description: Welcome to an unforgettable experience through breathtaking scenery with a finish at the idyllic Sirevåg harbor! The race is approximately 7 km long and suitable for most people. Along the way, you will encounter fun obstacles and tunnels from World War II. You can choose an alternative exercise if an obstacle becomes too challenging. Sign up your team today to experience the adventure for yourself!
course_highlights: The race goes through a fantastic landscape, tunnels from World War II, and finishes in the idyllic Sirevåg harbor.
The course is 7 km long with 17-20 different obstacles.
We arrange the transport of your equipment from start to finish.

images.alt_text: Participants in the Coastal Hunter Race cross a muddy obstacle.
Overview image of a beautiful landscape with runners on a path near water.
Course map for the Kystjegerløpet in Sirevåg, a trail run of approximately 7 km.

name: Grimstad Marathon
description: Grimstad Marathon 2025 will take place on Saturday, September 13, 2025, featuring a new, centrally located, and fast course. No matter the distance, the audience will cheer you on and follow you for much of the way. Choose the distance that suits you best, whether you're running with friends, colleagues, or alone. The course includes 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon at 21 km, with the start and finish in Byhaven in the Grimstad harbor area, offering a varied experience that includes both sea, forest, and inland scenery.
course_highlights: The course is 5 km and is run one, two, or four times, while the half marathon runners complete an extra loop in the turnaround area to reach 21 km.
The start and finish are in Byhaven in the Grimstad harbor area, and the course takes you past Odden and out along Grooseveien to the Groos bathing area.
No matter which distance you choose, it will be a running celebration with aid stations and cheers throughout the race.

images.alt_text: Runners at the finish line of a race, with bib numbers and the finish arch.
Runners who start a race under a yellow arch.
Boats in Grimstad harbor, with white houses in the background.
Course map for a marathon.

name: Hedersløpet
description: The Honor Run is a unique, slightly different race that brings together all running enthusiasts, both military and civilian, to honor our veterans, both the living and those who have passed away. The race passes by the Memorial Grove and is certified and approved by Kondis as a quality race. It is open to all runners with two distances, 5 km and 10 km, where the 5 km can be walked as a march. The Honor Run was established in 2017 as a joint project by NVIO branch Oslo and several partners, and since then, it has seen increasing participation.
course_highlights: The race honors our veterans, both the living and those who have passed away.
There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, where the 5 km can be walked as a march.
The project is non-commercial and all profits go to the Veteran Assistance Foundation.

images.alt_text: Runner with medal in front of the Honor Race banner.
Runners in the Honor Race.
Map of an area with buildings and entrances.

name: Valdresløpet
description: We challenge you to a trail run that truly tests your running capacity and terrain skills in our half marathon. The race takes place on September 13, 2025, and covers a distance of 21.1 km with an elevation gain of 570 m. We hope this course includes everything a trail half marathon should have. The Valdresløpet has been held every year since 1978 and attracts 200-250 participants annually, featuring a varied route from Fagernes to Leirin.
course_highlights: This year's race will take place in new surroundings, starting in the Park at Fagernes and finishing at the Airport in Leirin.
The race is organized in familiar and safe formats with three checkpoints along the way, at Sebufjorden, Storefoss, and Skrautvål kindergarten.
Participants will also receive a running puzzle to solve along the way.

images.alt_text: Scenic landscape with a lake and mountains, possibly from the Valdresløpet trail run.
Scenic landscape with water, trees, and a bridge. Potentially related to the Valdresløpet.

name: Trolljegerprøven Bergen Junior
description: The Troll Hunter Trial Bergen Junior is an exciting obstacle course in Norwegian nature, with a distance of 8 km +. The course features over 30 obstacles, in addition to natural barriers, and is designed so that everyone can participate. Join us for a family-friendly day at Fløien with a 3+ km trail run and 20+ challenging obstacles, perfect for the whole family, groups of friends, and sports teams.
course_highlights: The Troll Hunter Challenge is an 8 km+ long obstacle course in Norwegian nature with 30+ obstacles.
Family Day at Fløien includes a 3+ km trail run with 20+ obstacles for extra challenges.
The race is designed so that everyone can complete it, providing a sense of achievement and fun.

name: Steinfjellstafetten
description: The Steinfjell Relay is an annual relay event held in Namsskogan and Røyrvik, spanning two days with varied stages, terrain, and landscapes. This is a major event each year, where everyone can participate! The course consists of several stages with varying distances, allowing participants to experience the beautiful nature and challenging terrain. Each stage has its own distance and difficulty level, making the relay both exciting and accessible for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The Steinfjell Relay takes place in picturesque surroundings in Namsskogan and Røyrvik.
The relay features varied legs with distances ranging from 4.2 km to 10.3 km.
The event is accessible to runners of different levels, making it an exciting experience for everyone.

name: Fjordkraft Bergen City Milen
description: It is a pleasure to welcome you to the Fjordkraft Bergen City Mile, a flat 10 km race in the heart of Bergen. The race is held for the seventh time on September 12, 2026, starting at 16:00 from Torgallmenningen. The organizing club TIF Viking invites everyone to another running celebration in the streets of Bergen, and all participants will receive a medal.
course_highlights: There are cash prizes for the top three in the women's and men's categories.
There is also an activity park for children and a Mini-Milen (children's race) of 600 meters.

images.alt_text: Runners in the Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon.

Fjordkraft Bergen City Mile on September 14. Race and children's race. Sign up!

name: Markus-løpet
description: The Markus Race is now being held for the fifth time and is drawing attention to the gold ribbon, the international symbol for childhood cancer. The proceeds go to childhood cancer research and Cancer Care Rogaland. The race takes place on Saturday, September 13, 2025, with options of a 5 km or 10 km timed race, as well as a 3 km walk/run without timing. Whether you run or walk, you contribute to an important cause while enjoying a unique experience in the beautiful Jæren landscape.
course_highlights: The proceeds go to children's cancer research and Cancer Care Rogaland.
Honorary prizes and awards are distributed in various categories during the event.
Vitengarden/Jærmuseet keeps its entire facility open to everyone in the area.

images.alt_text: Markus Run poster with runner, logo, and support for childhood cancer research.
Runners in the Markus Race 2025 will run through a wooded area.

name: Solidaritetsløp Palestina
description: Solidarity run for Palestine takes place on Saturday, September 13, 2025, starting at 12:00 in Oslo, to raise funds for Palestine. This is a social, active way to show solidarity with Palestine while contributing financially where it is needed most. The course starts and ends in Kubaparken, with running along the Akerselva. Participants can choose between distances of 5 km and 10 km, with those running 10 km completing the 5 km loop twice.
course_highlights: The proceeds from ticket sales go to the Palestinian Red Crescent and the Artificial Limbs and Polio Centre workshop in Gaza.
The Solidarity Run for Palestine aims to be visible in the urban landscape, in the spirit of the running group Run for Palestine Oslo.
The course runs along the beautiful Akerselva, providing participants with a great nature experience while showing solidarity.

name: Kongskleiven Opp
description: Kongskleivo is Bekkjarvik's most popular hike. Here, with the help of a beautiful sherpa path through stunning nature, you will reach the summit of Kongsfjellet, where legends say a king is buried. On the way to the top, you can stop by Taushaugen, where you can catch your breath and enjoy the view over Bekkjarvik. If you're lucky, you might also have a unique encounter with the best wildlife the West Coast has to offer, namely the sea eagle and wild sheep.
course_highlights: Kongskleivo is Bekkjarvik's most popular hike.
You will reach the summit of Kongsfjellet where legends say a king is buried.
On the way to the top, you can take a breather and enjoy the view of Bekkjarvik from Taushaugen.

images.alt_text: Girl wins Stolzekleiven Uphill. Congratulations!
Runner in Kongskleiven Up with number 1420.

name: Lilo Trail
description: LiloTrail is a free and casual half marathon on trails in Lillomarka. The race starts and ends at Solemskogen, which is located in the heart of Lillomarka, and it takes 35 minutes to get there by tram and bus from Oslo S. The course features a varied route that includes downhill sections, paths along water, and climbs to viewpoints. Participants are advised to bring nutrition and water, as there are opportunities to refill along the way.
course_highlights: The race starts and ends at Solemskogen, which is located in the heart of Lillomarka.
The course features a varied route that includes downhill sections, trails along the water, and ascents to viewpoints.
Participants are advised to bring nutrition and water, as there will be opportunities to refuel along the way.

images.alt_text: Runners at the start of the Lilo Trail half marathon.
Signs on the Lilo Trail route in Lillomarka direct you to Lilloseter and Sinober.

name: Skjervøy 20:1000
description: Skjervøy 20:1000 is a mountain race suited for the fittest, and a manageable challenge for those who need a goal to strive for. The idyllic little island offers variety with steep paths up and down, narrow trails, cart paths in hilly terrain, and boardwalks over marshy areas. The race includes high speed, demanding uphill sections, and technically challenging routes, all around the center of Skjervøy in scenic surroundings. At the edge of the open sea at 70 degrees north.
course_highlights: Steep trails up and down, narrow paths, cart tracks in hilly terrain, and crossings over marshland.
High speed, steep climbs, technically challenging trails.
Skjervøy 20:1000 is a manageable challenge for those who need a goal to strive for.

name: Skarsteinsetra Opp
description: Skarsteinsetra Opp is a mountain race that was first held in 2011. Here, runners and cyclists start simultaneously in Olden center and compete to be the first to reach Skarsteinsetra, creating many exciting duels. The recreational class is open to everyone, and many participants come with strollers, contributing to a festive atmosphere in the finish area. The finish line is at the idyllic Skarsteinsetra, which boasts one of the finest views in the area. The course is 4.6 km long with an elevation gain of 400 m.
course_highlights: The recreational class has good participation, and this contributes to a festive atmosphere in the finish area.
There is a sprint prize at Skarsteinstunet after 1.2 km and a split time at Gildestad after 2.8 km.
Prize money for course records for women and men, as well as the best times for boys, girls, women, and men.

name: Crazy Race - Sandefjord
description: Crazy Race - Sandefjord is Norway's funniest obstacle race suitable for everyone! It gives you the opportunity to experience an exciting and varied obstacle course, perfect for individuals and groups such as friends, colleagues, or family. The event promises a day filled with fun, challenges, and memories for a lifetime. Join the most bouncy obstacle race of the fall and bring everyone you know!
course_highlights: Crazy Race - Sandefjord is Norway's funniest obstacle race suitable for everyone!
The event promises a day filled with fun, challenges, and memories for a lifetime.
Participants can expect a challenging and varied course that takes them through beautiful surroundings.

name: Oslo Maraton 10 km
description: The Oslo Marathon 10 km is part of the BMW Oslo Marathon and has a minimum age requirement of 13 years for participation. There will be several waves with start times from 4:20 PM and onwards, and the maximum time to complete the race is 1 hour and 45 minutes. Participants will pass water stations located approximately every 5 kilometers, and there will be pacers available to help runners achieve their goals.
course_highlights: Senay Fissehatsion won the "10 for Grete" for men during today's BMW Oslo Marathon in the streets of Oslo.
Both the start and finish for all distances in the BMW Oslo Marathon are at Rådhusplassen in Oslo.

name: Hydro Rundt
description: Hydro Rundt is a recreational race without classification. The course is 5.0 km, easy to run, and goes around the Hydro Aluminium Karmøy factory area, alternating between gravel and asphalt. Hydro Rundt 2025 will be held this year for the 49th time and will be spring's most beautiful adventure.
course_highlights: The course is 5.0 km, easy to run, and circles around the Hydro Aluminium Karmøy factory area.
Hydro Rundt 2025 will be held this year for the 49th time.
The course alternates between gravel and asphalt.

name: Dogrun - Stavanger
description: VOM DOGRUN is a social activity for both dogs and their owners, and we are once again coming to Stavanger to host a real dog party in collaboration with Mosvangen Camping. Join us for a social and fun outing around the beautiful Mosvatnet, in the company of other dog lovers. Participants can choose to take part with or without timing, and everyone will receive a participation medal. Welcome to the whole family – both two-legged and four-legged!
course_highlights: VOM Dogrun is for everyone who wants to participate in a pleasant activity with their dog.
You can choose with or without timing, and there is a participation medal for everyone.
The run is a social and fun outing with your dog, in the company of other dog lovers.

name: Strandmila
description: Strandamilå takes place on May 1, 2025, and registration is now open! This is a great opportunity to shake off the winter slumber and participate in the race. Sign up through the distances at the top of the menu. We are also looking for pacers, so if you want to help running enthusiasts achieve their goals, you can contribute as a strong and steady pacer!
course_highlights: Strandamilå May 1, 2025. Registration is now open!
Sign up through the distances at the top of the menu!

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, Halvmaraton
description: The Personal Record Race 5 km, 10 km, Half Marathon is an exciting event that offers distances for all types of runners. The course is fast and flat, designed for records, and is AIMS-certified. Participants can enjoy a scenic route while competing, and it’s a great opportunity to gather friends and family for an active day outdoors. Results are available immediately after finishing, and there is free parking.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course, designed for records. AIMS-certified course.
Results available immediately after finishing.
The race takes place on a scenic route that allows participants to enjoy the surroundings while they compete.

name: Lina Roindt
description: Lina Roindt is a road race that takes place on September 18, starting and finishing at Torshall in Bolme, Rindal. The competitive runners completed a lap of 10.8 km around Rindal center, while recreational participants could choose between two options: one lap around Rinnvollen (3 km) and one around the center via Sunnabrua (6.7 km). This year, a total of 295 people participated, making it the largest starting field since 1993. Lina Roindt is known as the big family day, with high participation and an efficient recreational committee.
course_highlights: Great participation in the Lina Roindt, with 238 in the fun run category without timing and 25 in the competitive categories, totaling 263 participants.
42 of the participants lined up in the starting field that raced for time, the largest starting field since 1993.
There was excitement about whether Strindheim runner Ebrahim Abdulaziz could break the nearly 30-year-old course record set by Dag Øxnvad.

images.alt_text: Children and adults are running in a race, with bib numbers on their chests.

name: Frogn på langs
description: Frogn Longways 2025 takes place on Sunday, September 14, and is a cultural hiking march and trail run for the whole family. The route goes through varying forest and cultural landscapes via historical sites in Frogn, providing a great opportunity to get to know the municipality. Drinks will be served at five checkpoints, but it is recommended to bring your own drinks and packed lunch for those who wish to complete the entire route. Participants can choose to start from Ramme or Follo Museum, and the trail run starts at 10:00 AM with distances of 10 or 28 km.
course_highlights: The route goes through varying forest and cultural landscapes via historical sites in Frogn, and is a great opportunity to get to know our beautiful municipality.
Drinks will be served at the five refreshment stations, but we still recommend that you, as a walker, bring your own drinks and packed lunch.
Frogn along the way is a massive public health initiative, and the organizers have put in a lot of effort to ensure that participants can enjoy top-notch trails.

name: Mosviksenderen Rundt
description: Mosviksenderen Rundt is an exciting race experience that takes participants through beautiful scenic landscapes in Mosvik. The courses are varied and include both gravel roads and trails, providing a challenging yet rewarding experience. Participants can expect to see fantastic views of the fjord and the surrounding mountains while running. This year, the race was held for the 44th time on Sunday, September 26, 2021, with participants running distances of 2 km, 6 km, 8 km, and 11 km.
course_highlights: 22 runners lined up at the starting line when the Mosviksenderen Rundt took place last weekend.
Bjørn Dahle from Mosvik IL was the winner of this year's race in the long course, 11 km.
Participants can expect to see stunning views of the fjord and the surrounding mountains while they run.

name: Moovløpet
description: Welcome to the Moov Race on September 15th in Drammen! This is a low-threshold race with a flat and nice course profile, starting and finishing at the Ypsilon Bridge. The children's race starts at 10:00 AM, and all participants receive a medal. The mass start for the 5 km and 10 km races is at 11:00 AM. The entry fee is 250 NOK for non-members, while Moov members participate for free.
course_highlights: Children's race with a medal for all participants at 10:00.
Mass start for 5 km and 10 km at 11:00.
Low-threshold running with a great atmosphere.

name: Dokkarunden
description: The Dokkarunden is an exciting race that takes participants through beautiful and varied landscapes. The course is 10 km long and is perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants will have the opportunity to experience nature up close, with several highlights along the route, including spectacular views and challenging terrain. The race takes place on Sunday, September 15, 2024, at 1:00 PM from Dokka Stadium.
course_highlights: The course is 10 km long and is perfect for both beginners and experienced runners.
Participants will have the opportunity to experience nature up close.
There are several highlights along the route, including spectacular views and challenging terrain.

name: Seterløpet
description: Seterløpet, Norway's oldest race, is organized from Solumsmoen in Sigdal to Vestre Spone Sports Ground. The race, which is 18.5 km long, has a mass start for competitive runners at 11:00 AM, while recreational runners can start from 9:00 AM. There is organized transportation from Vestre Spone Sports Ground at around 9:30 AM, and registration takes place at the start. This race is a collaboration between Nedre Sigdal Sports Club and Vestre Spone IF.
course_highlights: The Seterløpet was first held in 1936 and is thus Norway's oldest race.
The race has a mass start for the competitive class at 11:00 AM, while recreational runners can start from 9:00 AM.
There is organized transportation from Vestre Spone sports field to the starting location.

name: Dalajoggen Høst
description: Dalajoggen Autumn takes place on May 16, where you can walk, jog, or cycle around Sagslotten and participate in a draw for great prizes. The start is at 6:00 PM from the Youth House, and the course consists of one or two laps of 5 and 10 km. If you wish to run for time, you can register via the link: https://live.eqtiming.com/72350#dashboard. For only NOK 200, you can also sign up for all our races, and it's free for children under 16 years old.
course_highlights: You can walk, jog, or cycle around Sagslotten and participate in the drawing for great prizes.
The course consists of one or two laps of 5 and 10 km.
For just NOK 200, you can register for all our races, and it's free for children under 16 years old.

The start is at 6:00 PM from the Youth House, and the course consists of one or two laps of 5 and 10 km.
For children under 16 years old, participation is free.

name: Næsløpet Høst
description: On Saturday, the Næsløpet was held for the second time, in brilliant sunshine. Around 60 active runners of all ages participated in the race at Stavsjø, some in the 10-kilometer and others in the 5-kilometer. Cecilie Kvehaugen Hansen was among the participants, and she expressed joy that there are competitions for everyone. With enthusiasm and happiness, the participants ran across the finish line, and Maja Kvehaugen Draganovic described the experience as both exhausting and fun.
course_highlights: Around 60 active runners of all ages participated in the race at Stavsjø.
Participants could choose between the 10-kilometer and the 5-kilometer.
Cecilie Kvehaugen Hansen stated that it is great that there are competitions like these that are for everyone.

name: Romerike Løpskarusell 8
description: Romerike Running Carousel is a running series with 8 different races spread across Romerike. Running is for everyone and is a social and enjoyable activity. You can choose whether you want to walk, jog, or run, with or without timing. You can register for the entire running series or sign up for individual races. Prize for everyone who completes 4 out of 8 races!
course_highlights: Romerike Running Carousel offers 8 different races with unique routes.
Participants can earn points throughout the series.
Prizes are awarded to those who complete a certain number of races.

name: Østmarka Dogrun
description: VOM Dogrun is once again coming to Østmarka and organizing a real dog party outside Rustadsaga sports lodge. Join us for a social and fun outing with your dog, in the company of other dog lovers. You can choose to participate with or without timing, and there is a participant medal for everyone. Welcome to the whole family – both two-legged and four-legged!
course_highlights: Join a social and fun outing with your dog, in the company of other dog lovers.
You can choose with or without timing, and there is a participation medal for everyone.
Welcome to the whole family – both two-legged and four-legged!

name: Holavatnet Rundt 16
description: The Summer Carousel Holavatnet Round was first organized in 1983 and is now in its 41st season. On average, about 130 people show up every Wednesday to exercise or test their fitness in the scenic course that goes around Holavatnet. The course is 3.1 km long and consists of asphalt and gravel paths, and it is easy to take a stroller along for the round.
course_highlights: The course runs around Holavatnet on asphalt/gravel paths, providing a scenic experience.
The course is 3.1 km long, with 1.1 km of asphalt, 1.8 km of gravel road, and 0.2 km of asphalt.
There is a nature trail for children in the hiking class, with a prize located at the "cabin" (about 450 meters above sea level).

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 6
description: The Åsane Running Carousel is an exciting race series taking place in Bergen, Norway, from January to October 2024. Participants can choose between distances of 5 km and 10 km, with the starting gun at 19:00 for the 10 km and 19:05 for the 5 km. Race numbers will be distributed on race day from 18:00 to 18:45, and carousel participants will be assigned green race numbers that are valid for the entire season.
course_highlights: Participants can choose between the distances of 5 km and 10 km.
Start gun at 7:00 PM for 10 km and 7:05 PM for 5 km.
Race numbers will be distributed on race day from 6:00 PM to 6:45 PM.

name: Bryneløpet
description: This year's Bryneløp takes place on Saturday, September 13, during the Potato Festival (September 12-14). The race is organized for children in elementary school (grades 1-7) and has been held since 2013. Participants start in groups for grades 1-2, grades 3-4, and grades 5-7 for both girls and boys. The course starts between M44 and Brynesenteret and goes around the lower part of Fritz Røed Park, in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The Bryne Race is a popular event that takes place in picturesque surroundings.
Participants can look forward to a varied and exciting course that takes them through both forests and open landscapes.
The race has several distances to choose from, making it accessible for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Stoltzekleiven Opp
description: Stoltzekleiven Opp is a race that has been part of the running calendar since 1979. The event takes place in Bergen and is known for being a challenging uphill climb. Participants get to experience a spectacular course that takes them up the steep Stoltzekleiven, a historic staircase with 722 steps. The race has a strong focus on community and includes both individual participants and groups, and it is organized every year in September by the sports club Varegg.
course_highlights: Stoltzekleiven Opp is reportedly the world's largest uphill race, with about 6,300 participants in recent years.
The race has an elevation gain of 301.44 meters and goes over approximately 800 steps.
The event spans two days, starting on Friday and Saturday of the last weekend in September from 9:15 AM to 6:15 PM each day.

name: Hodlekve Rundt Fjelløp
description: Join the ultimate mountain race in Hodlekve, featuring races of 21, 10, and 6 km in beautiful terrain. This is an activity day for both young and old, with partners like Rab and Intersport contributing with activities and great offers. The race starts and finishes at Dalalåven, with the starting gun for the 21 km at 10:00 and for the 10 km and 6 km at 10:30. The junior race and treasure hunt will begin after 10:30, and Dalalåven will have an open café with food and drink service.
course_highlights: Choose a beautiful round trip of about 21 km and 1000 meters of elevation over two mountains, a slightly shorter route of about 10 km and 500 meters of elevation, or a hiking trail of 6 km.
The secretariat is open in Dalalåven from 9:00 AM, and it is allowed to go out on the course to cheer for the runners.
At Dalalåven, there will be activities all day with maps and descriptions made available well in advance of the race.

name: Førde Rundt
description: On Saturday, September 20, 2025, we are hosting Førde Rundt for the first time! We hope to engage 1,000 people to run or walk our course, and we are preparing for camaraderie and joy in activity in 2025. Inspired by the Energistafetten in Stavanger, the New York Marathon, and the great atmosphere of the Tour de France, this street race is a community event for both runners and spectators. You can run alone or with friends and family, and if you’re not running, we need you to create an amazing atmosphere along the course!
course_highlights: Can we engage 1000 people to run or walk on our course?
We are inspired by the Energy Relay in Stavanger, the New York Marathon, and the great atmosphere of the Tour de France.
The street race is a community event for both runners and spectators.

description: CrazyRace is fun for the whole family, and the race is suitable for adults and children from 4 years old, regardless of experience or fitness level. You can run or walk at your own pace, and there are many fun and challenging obstacles along the way. Crazy Race Skedsmo is returning this fall, so bring the whole family and jump around on all our obstacles!
course_highlights: The race is suitable for adults and children from 4 years old, regardless of experience or fitness level.
You can run or walk at your own pace, and there are many fun and challenging obstacles along the way.
Crazy Race Skedsmo has 14 enormous inflatable obstacles that you won't want to miss!

name: Fýri Trail by Salomon
description: Fýri Trail By Salomon is happy to invite you to the final of the Salomon Golden Trail Nordic Series. Experience the magic of Scandinavia's finest trails with two distances: 29 km and 18 km. This race will test your trail skills and provide you with an incredible experience as you run along the mountain trails of Hemsedal, where you will discover technical paths, steep ascents, and untouched wilderness.
course_highlights: Two stages, the same superhero feeling at the finish line!
Discover everything from technical trails to steep hills and untouched wilderness.
Run along the shores of some beautiful lakes and explore some of the best trails Norway has to offer.

name: Flyplassmila
description: The Airport Mile 2025 will be held on Saturday, September 20, 2025, and is known for having the "world's fastest course" on the runway of Stord Airport, Sørstokken. The course is almost completely flat and has a straight direction, providing optimal conditions for setting personal records. Participants can choose between the distances of 5 kilometers and 10 kilometers, with certified and officially measured courses.
course_highlights: The course layout is on the runway at Stord Airport, with turns resembling an indoor athletics track, 11m radius/22m diameter.
One lap is 2.5 kilometers, and the course shows a total elevation gain of 7 meters on Strava.
Race numbers can be picked up at the terminal at the airport from 10:00 AM, so please be there in good time!

name: Trail Monkey
description:
Unleash your inner TrailMonkey! 

Are you ready to play through nature like a true TrailMonkey? Monkeytrail is not like other races – it’s a celebration of freedom, movement, and playfulness. Here, it’s not just about kilometers and seconds, but about muddy shoes, grins under fir trees, and the feeling of being wildly alive.

Your adventure awaits...

Choose between two epic courses:

    6KM Trail – perfect for those who want to challenge themselves in hilly, playful terrain.

    12KM Tough Monkey Edition – for those who can’t get enough of hills, slopes, and forest magic.

    18KM MonKey Banan – for those who want to go all in: more running, more mud, more madness. And maybe a banana at the finish line.

Run, climb, laugh – and become part of something bigger...

MonkeyTrail is made for both everyday heroes and wilderness veterans. Here we celebrate movement in nature – whether you leap over roots like a ninja monkey or take your time while inhaling forest air like a Zen monk on caffeine.

You don’t need top speed; you need a sense of adventure. And maybe a little balance.

Nature's superpowers (and why you become magical by participating)

    You get a better mood just by tying your shoelaces.

    The trees give you a free mental reboot.

    Every hill you conquer grants you +10 self-respect and +5 smiles.

    And mud? Well, it’s nature’s beauty treatment for the soul.

Medal for EVERYONE – Because you are a true TrailMonkey

Everyone who finishes receives the legendary TrailMonkey medal – proof that you master the terrain and dare to play. The winners are rewarded with honor, glory, and prizes – but everyone is rewarded with nature’s applause and a solid sense of achievement.

Join us!

Become part of the pack. Run and laugh. 
Monkeytrail – it’s not just a race. 
It’s the freedom in a pair of trail shoes.
course_highlights: Our events are made for everyone - from 5 km beginners to ultra marathon warriors - and are designed with inclusivity and boundary-breaking ideas in mind.
Navigate our well-marked trails safely with support from our experienced team, and feel the energy from our close-knit, supportive running community.
At the finish line, you celebrate your achievements not only with a medal but with a warm welcome from the community, and yes, some good old tea and cake!

name: Brakvatnet Halvmaraton Stafett
description: The Brakvatnet Half Marathon Relay takes place around the beautiful Brakvatnet in Osterøy municipality, consisting of 8 laps that total 21.1 km plus 337.5 m. The start is 337 m before the swimming area, and the finish line is at the swimming area. In the finish area, there are changing tents and toilets, as well as food sales. The course records are 1:18:01 set by Espen Borge Joensen in 2024 and 1:24:29 by Hilde Aasheim in 2013.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet + 337.5m.
In the finish area, there are changing tents (for women and men) and restrooms (for women and men).
The relay and half marathon start at 12:00 PM.

name: Hauernløpet
description: The Hauernløpet is a trail race of 19 km that mostly takes place on paths, with sections of gravel, through beautiful areas in Drammensmarka. The first five kilometers have an approximately 50/50 distribution between paths and gravel, while the next segment is almost exclusively on paths until 15 km. From 15 to 17 km, there is more gravel than path, before it returns to paths for the final stretch to the finish line. In total, there is about 75% path and 25% gravel.
course_highlights: The Hauern Race is a 19 km trail run.
The race goes through beautiful areas in Drammensmarka.
Overall, about 75% of the route is on trail and 25% on gravel.

name: Fædrelandsvennen Stafetten
description: The FVN Relay 2025 is organized by the Agder Corporate Sports Association in collaboration with Fædrelandsvennen. There will be competitions in mixed, women's, and men's categories, focusing on the joy of running, community, and team building. Each category consists of three legs, with each leg being approximately 2.2 km. The event will take place on Saturday, September 20, in Tresse, Kristiansand, and there will also be a separate active category for the fittest women and men participating in the mass start.
course_highlights: Emphasis is placed on the joy of running, community, and team building.
Each leg is approximately 2.2 km, and there are three legs per team.
There will be a separate active class for the fittest women and men who run the first mass start.

name: Muruvik Backyard Ultra
description: Ready for another round of the Muruvik Backyard Ultra? The race was first held in the spring of 2021, with another event already that fall. The course runs back and forth between Muruvik and Hommelvik along the picturesque Malvik Trail, a flat route with great record potential. Backyard ultra is simply explained as a race on a 6.7 km loop, where runners have one hour to complete the loop, and each full hour the race starts anew. The winner is the one who ultimately lasts a lap alone.
course_highlights: The route goes back and forth from Muruvik to Hommelvik along the picturesque Malvik Trail.
Flat course with good record opportunities.
The runners have one hour to complete the course, and every full hour, the race starts anew.

name: Stjernemila
description: The Stjernemila is a running event that starts in the center of Flekkefjord, right in the middle of the festivities! The course is approximately 10 kilometers long and follows a star-shaped route from the finish area, with six "arms" that take you to iconic locations in the center. The course is well-marked, and participants can have their leg times recorded on the big screen, providing the audience with a good overview. The event includes both the main race and a relay, as well as free children's races for the age groups 3-7 years and 8-12 years.
course_highlights: The runners take off in a star shape from the finish area, heading out into the 6 "arms" of the star, each of which is an iconic location in the center of Flekkefjord.
The course includes quite a few hills to reach the viewpoints, but it's no more than about 200 meters of elevation.
The Star Mile is more than just a race; the center will be buzzing with life and activities for both young and old, with exciting menus at the city's many outdoor venues in the evening.

name: Oppdalsløpet
description: The traditional Oppdal Race kicks off on Saturday, September 21 at 1:00 PM! The Oppdal Race is a 3.5 km long trail run, along gravel roads and paths, with the start and finish at the NOIL square. There is an opportunity to both run and walk, and the race is suitable for all ages. Pre-registration is possible until midnight on September 20, while late registration takes place on Saturday, September 21 between 12:00 and 12:30 at NOIL. Registration is free, and a trophy will be awarded to the fastest woman and man. Welcome!
course_highlights: The race is free, and there is an option for both running and walking.
Trophy for the fastest woman and man.
The Oppdal Race is part of the Oppdal Weekend, along with the bazaar in the NOIL house.

name: Kristiansand Backyard Ultra
description: The laps start every full hour, and your pace determines how long your break is before the next start. Although the ultimate goal is to reach 80.4 km, you are warmly welcome to run as many laps as you wish – or can manage. For us at Backyard Norway, running is not about showing off or the pursuit of being the best, but about overcoming oneself and pushing new boundaries. Regardless of whether this boundary is at 10, 25, or 80 km, all runners are welcome, and the last participant to finish has performed just as strongly as the first.
course_highlights: The laps start every hour on the hour, and your pace determines how long of a break you get before the next start.
Even though the ultimate goal is to reach 80.4 km, you are warmly welcome to run as many laps as you want – or can manage.
Running is a lifestyle and a leisure activity, and we want to challenge ourselves and push new boundaries.

name: Kongeløpet
description: The King’s Race is a recreational run that goes from Byrknesøy to Skjerjehamn. The race covers a distance of 13 km, over bridges and islands, on asphalt in beautiful coastal scenery. Just hilly enough to be challenging.
additional:
The King’s Race is a recreational run that goes from Joker on Byrknesøy to Skjerjehamn on Sandøy. It is a collaborative project between Ytre Gulen Sports Club and Skjerjehamn. There are 3 water stations along the route. Organizers assist with the transport of equipment from the starting point to the finish line.

Entry fee for the race number is 150,-.
course_highlights: Varied selection of distances from 0.5 km to 13 km.
The race takes place in picturesque surroundings in Øvre Eiker.
Suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.

images.alt_text: View of a bridge over the water, not related to the King’s Race.

name: Skeikampen Opp
description: Skeikampen Opp is a mountain race from the base of Skeikampen to the stone hut at the top. The race is suitable for both active athletes and recreational runners of all ages, so there's no excuse not to participate. It is 2.9 km long and consists of 340 meters of elevation gain. You can choose which category you want to compete in, with a recreational category for those who do not wish to be timed. The competitive categories start in waves according to age from 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The race takes place in scenic surroundings from the foot of Skeikampen to the stone cabin at the top!
You can choose to start between 11:00 AM and 11:30 AM if you are participating in the recreational class.
The competition classes start in waves based on age, with the first start at 12:00 PM for men aged 17 to 49.

After the Hvalerløpet was concluded in the autumn of 2019, we at Hvaler IL - who previously had the role of volunteers during the race - decided to organize a race that is at least as fantastic. This race offers a unique experience in coastal nature and includes several distances for all levels.
course_highlights: The first edition of Hvalermila was held in 2021 - welcome to the fifth edition in 2025!
Join the autumn running festival in stunning nature.
We at Hvaler IL want to organize a race that is at least as fantastic as the Hvaler Race.

description: Join us for a run around the beautiful Trommedalen at the Bondemarknaden in Etne. Monica Hundseid will participate in the race, which has a distance of approximately 8.2 km. In October, the Bondespretten race was organized to raise funds for the organization Mat onna bronå in Haugesund, and a total of 3,000 kroner was collected from the entry fees.

name: Ulvøyløpet
description: Join a beautiful trail run through the stunning landscapes of Hadseløya, right in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen! Lace up your running shoes, experience the spectacular views, and let the flow trails give you an extra boost. Whether you're chasing your personal record, seeking a real challenge, or simply wanting a fantastic nature experience, the trails of Hadseløya are ready for you!
course_highlights: Runners can start from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM, and families with children are encouraged to start as early as possible and take the short route.
There will be a bonfire at the drink station at Sorgenfri, where there will also be sticks for grilling sausages.
There will be a cafe at Melbu near the finish line, providing participants the opportunity to enjoy something nice after the race.

name: Erslandsvatnet Rundt
description: Erslandsvatnet Rundt took place on Saturday, September 24, 2022, with 23 participants in the competitive class. The race was 3.75 kilometers long, and IL Ternen's own Johannes Heien finished first with a time of 14:09, having also been the best the previous year. Stine Hatteberg was the only woman to complete the race, with a time of 19:01. For the family and recreational class, the start was at Skarveland school between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM, with no timing.

Johannes Heien from IL Ternen crossed the finish line first with a time of 14:09.

name: Driv Karusell Løp
description: The Driv Carousel (cross-country running) concludes with the final race on FRIDAY, September 7th at Drivplassen. The last race is also the club championship for all members of Driv IL aged 10 and above, as well as an awards ceremony. The Driv Carousel starts with the first race on Friday, April 22nd, with additional race dates on Fridays: April 29th, September 22nd, and September 9th. The price for all 4 races is 200 NOK.
course_highlights: The last race is the club championship for all members of Driv IL aged 10 and up, as well as an awards ceremony.

The course is partly gravel and partly asphalt, so it is important to dress appropriately and be prepared for changing weather conditions.

description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses, and the race takes place on a wide pathway that is well-used by runners and joggers in the Drammen area. With a distance of 10 km, this race offers a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to test their skills.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway.
The race is well-utilized by runners and recreational athletes in the Drammen area.

name: Ørsjødilten
description: We warmly welcome everyone to this year's "ØRSJØ-DILT". The race takes place at Prestebakke and has been organized for 40 years, attracting participants of all ages. The participants run the first 2.5 km together with the 8 and 21 km routes, around the football field and the lit trail, before continuing on gravel and finishing with 1.5 km in terrain. There is a lot of beautiful nature along Ørsjøen, and it is a fantastic opportunity for both locals and visitors to take part in an inclusive and enjoyable event.
course_highlights: The runners start with a lap around the football field and then 1.9 km of hilly terrain in the lighted trail.
There is an elevation gain of 60 m at the end of the 5.5 km gravel section.
Drinks and bananas are available at 6, 12, and 15 km.

name: Nybrottkarusellen 4. løp
description: The Nybrottkarusellen 2024 is open to everyone, both recreational runners and competitive athletes, and invites you to an unforgettable atmosphere alongside fellow running enthusiasts! The start and finish for all races are at Øverlands Minde, Stjørdal. The off-track routes are certified and approved, easy to run, and the surface on the track is relatively new and very runnable, providing great opportunities to set personal bests. New this year is a team competition for the 5 km, where the 3 best times for each team are combined.

name: Loddefjordløpet
description: The Loddefjord Race is an annual event that takes place in Bergen, Hordaland, and has been organized by Loddefjord IL Athletics for over 40 years. This year's race event will be held on Sunday, September 22, starting at 10:00 in Alvøen Sports Park. The race offers a varied and scenic route suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances of 5 km, 2 km, and a free children's race of 400 m for grades 1-4. We aim to create an inclusive low-threshold running festival that inspires physical activity for children and families throughout western Bergen.
course_highlights: The Loddefjord Race has been held for over 40 years and offers a scenic route through beautiful areas in Loddefjord.
The children's race of 400m for grades 1-4 is completely free to participate in, and all children receive a medal for their effort.
The event has distances of 5 km and 2 km, making it accessible for both experienced runners and beginners.

name: Borredalsløpet
description: Borredalsløpet is a 10 km race that takes place on gravel roads and some on mountain trails in Fredrikstadmarka. The first race was held in 1988, and since then the courses have remained the same, although the names of the races and the locations for the start and finish have varied. In 2014, the first race that went in the opposite direction was organized. The best man ran it in 21:40, while the best woman completed the 5.6-kilometer stretch in 29:41.
course_highlights: The first race was held in 1988.
The courses have been the same, but the names of the races and the locations for the start and finish have varied.

name: Oslo Trail Challenge
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon in the forest areas of Nordmarka, Lillomarka, and Romeriksåsen north of Oslo city center. Welcome to the Oslo Trail Challenge from September 27-29, 2024. The trails are unmarked, and you are responsible for navigating to stay on course, either by using GPS tracks or paper maps. Participants can choose between distances of 200 km, 100 km, and 55 km.

name: Heim Halvmaraton
description: Kyrksæterøra Athletic Club, track and field division, invites you to the Heim Half Marathon along the beautiful Hemnefjord! Sunday, September 22, 2024, at 12:00, with the start and finish at KulØrn. The course is 7 km, running through the center of Kyrksæterøra and along the fjord, and the loop is completed three times, creating a fantastic and fast half marathon route on an easy and flat course. There will be drink stations available along the way, and there is a common start for all classes at 12:00. Prizes will be awarded to the top 3 women and men.
course_highlights: The course is 7 km and runs through the center of Kyrksæterøra and a stretch along the fjord.
The lap is run three times and provides a great and fast half marathon course on an easy and flat route.

name: Rosa sløyfe-løpet
description: The Pink Ribbon Run raises awareness for breast cancer and the proceeds go to the Pink Ribbon Campaign. Participants can choose between a short course of about 2-3 km without timing, or a long course of about 5-6 km with timing. The event focuses on camaraderie, the joy of running, and engagement, and last year, a total of 21,090 people participated. It's not about how fast you run, but about spreading awareness for an important cause and showing solidarity.
course_highlights: The Pink Ribbon Run is a powerful symbol of solidarity and togetherness, and half of the entry fee goes directly to the breast cancer cause.
The course in Trondheim runs along the Nidelven, with the start and finish area in front of Nidaros Cathedral, and is accessible for both runners and wheelchair users.
The event has been held for the ninth time and focuses on celebrating life, even though breast cancer is a serious illness.

name: Tekna Veldedighetsløp
description:
The charity run is being organized for the second year in a row and will take place on September 28th. This year, just like last year, we want to highlight the importance of students' mental health. Mental health is a topic that never goes out of date, and we must continue to work on it so that we can constantly improve our ability to tackle the challenges that everyday life presents to us.

We want to support and shed light on the services provided by Mental Helse Ungdom with the funds we manage to raise. The registration fee paid upon signing up goes entirely to Mental Helse Ungdom.

Although we are running to benefit students' mental health, we want to invite adults of all ages to join in and run. The course will be set around the large Lungegårdsvann – a distance that is manageable regardless of fitness level. Participants can choose whether they want to run, walk, or contribute as cheerleaders.

Join us and use your legs for a good cause!
course_highlights: The charity run brings together students and other fitness enthusiasts for a race to support Mental Health Youth.
The event emphasizes the importance of students' mental health.
Join a meaningful running experience in the beautiful surroundings around Store Lungegårdsvann.

name: Steinkjer Skogsmaraton
description: With 87 registered participants and positive feedback from the 2025 event, we are already looking forward to the Steinkjer Forest Marathon 2026. The course is tough and challenging, but also offers a sense of achievement and experience. The route winds through beautiful surroundings on the fantastic trails of Oftenåsen, with the start and finish at the parking lot by the Steinkjer Shooting Range. During the Steinkjer Forest Marathon, you will experience the stunning Trøndelag nature while also feeling lactic acid building up to your ears.
course_highlights: The course route is tough and challenging, but at the same time, it offers mastery and experience.
The course winds through beautiful surroundings on the fantastic trails of Oftenåsen.

description: RE-MILA is a fun run for absolutely everyone, with distances of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The race starts at 2:00 PM with a children's race for the youngest, followed by the 2.5 km at 2:30 PM and a mass start for the 5 km and 10 km at 3:00 PM. Participants receive a medal upon finishing, and there are prizes for category winners and the best runners in each distance. All distances start and finish in Revetal town center, and parking is free.

The races will take place over 6 Mondays, with three races in the spring and three in the fall. In 2025, a total of 6 race carousels will be held, starting at 7:00 PM, and the 900-meter race will start at 6:30 PM for children born in 2017 and later.

name: Hønefoss 5 km
description: Hønefoss 5 km is an easy and fast course, officially measured by Kondis in June 2018, where many participants achieve personal records. The route mostly runs along the picturesque Storelva, with its highest point in Søndre Park, where runners are greeted by lively music from Hallingby School Band. The course consists of approximately 3 km of trail/gravel road and 2 km of asphalt, making it ideal for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Engeløya Rundt
description: Engeløya around Steigen is a beautiful route that takes you around the island of Engeløya. The course follows County Road 638, giving participants the chance to experience the fantastic nature and landscape that the island has to offer. The trip around the island is just over thirty kilometers, and the only noticeable uphill is at Mjeldskardet, where you ascend around fifty meters. Engeløya features both a war museum with Batterie Dietl and a one-kilometer-long sandy beach, Bøsanden, with an exceptionally beautiful location.
course_highlights: Most of the route is nearly flat and runs close to the sea and the cultural landscape of the island.
Engeløya has both a war museum with Batterie Dietl, one of the largest cannons made during World War II.
From the west and north sides of the island, one can see the midnight sun and parts of the Lofoten Wall on the other side of the Vestfjord.

name: Sjusjøløpet
description: On Saturday, August 9th, the Sjusjøløpet will take place from the Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, and many cross-country skiers are expected at the starting line. This race, which is being held for the second time after a successful debut in 2013, offers two distances: Sollifjellet Rundt at 21.5 kilometers and Sjusjøvannet Rundt at 10.5 kilometers. The courses traverse scenic areas such as Sollifjell, Mostefjell, and Snørrvillen, with the start and finish at the Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena. The organizing committee wishes everyone good luck and hopes for high participation.
course_highlights: The Sjusjøløpet offers a choice between two distances: Sollifjellet Rundt at 21.5 kilometers and Sjusjøvannet Rundt at 10.5 kilometers.
The trails traverse some of the mountains surrounding the sports venue; Sollifjell, Mostefjell, and Snørvillen, offering fantastic views.

The starting point is at the sports field in Sandane center, where there are also changing rooms, showers, restrooms, a kiosk, and parking available.

name: Hanatrappene Opp
description: Hanatrappene Up is a mountain race taking place on Sunday, October 27th at 12:00 in Sandnes. The race ascends the 306 steps to Hanafjedle, which is likely Northern Europe's longest outdoor staircase and a popular training destination. The staircase was completed in 1955 and connects the old Hana school with the sports facility. Sandnes Idrettslag is proud to invite you to this unique race in the historic stairs.
course_highlights: The race goes up 306 steps straight up to Hanafjedle.
The stairs are a popular target for training sessions and are defined as a school route.

name: Rauma Backyard Ultra
description: Rauma Backyard Ultra is an exciting trail ultramarathon that combines the challenge of running in nature with the unique format of a backyard race. Participants must complete a lap at a set distance within an hour, after which they have the option to take a break before the next lap starts. This continues as long as the participants wish to compete, creating an intense and strategic atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Rauma, Møre og Romsdal, offering participants the chance to experience the stunning nature of the area.
course_highlights: The participants must complete a lap at a set distance within one hour.

name: Nesbyen Backyard
description:
Nesbyen Backyard 6- and 12-Hour  
Detailed info at runnershei.com  

Date and location: October 4, Nesbyen, Hallingdal. Start at Nesbyen Sports Hall at 10:00 AM.  

Format: 6 or 12-hour Backyard run. Participants must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour to continue. The course is flat and fast, primarily on asphalt with sections of gravel and trail.  

Registration:  

- 490 NOK until April 30, 2025  
- 590 NOK until June 30, 2025  
- 690 NOK until August 31, 2025  
- 750 NOK until registration closes on September 15, 2025  

Transport:  

- Car: Via national road 7. 2 hours drive from Oslo and Drammen, 1 hour 15 minutes from Hønefoss and Fagernes, 1 hour from Rødberg and Geilo  
- Train: Bergen Line, 20-minute walk from the station to the sports hall  
- Bus: Check VY for timetables  

Prizes:  

- Prize for all who complete one loop, and the seventh loop (optional for 6 hours)  
- The three best in each category + top 3 overall (last loop and average speed)

Contact:  

- Phone: +47 400 98 514  
- Email: hei@runnershei.com
course_highlights: October in Nesbyen provides a fresh and exciting backdrop, with temperatures ranging from 0-15 °C.

Headlamps and reflective gear are mandatory for the darker hours, which both ensures the safety of participants and adds an extra dimension to the running experience.

name: Bèrghem Ultra Marathon
description: Bèrghem Ultra Trail is our classic trail running event, offering a range of trail running distances, all set against the stunning backdrop of Hedmarksvidda. This area is home to some of Norway's untouched forests and a well-known witch mountain. Runners can expect a mix of marked trails and marked/unmarked gravel roads, but the real challenge lies in the bogs and wetlands that dominate the entire region. Don't be fooled by the low profile - this terrain is some of the toughest in Norway.

description: Hamar Backyard Ultra 50M is a running competition organized according to the "Backyard" principle, originating from Big's Backyard Ultra in Tennessee, USA. The course is 6706 meters long and must be completed once every hour; anyone who fails to meet the deadline for the next start is out. The competition has a maximum duration of 12 hours, allowing for a maximum distance of 80467 meters, equivalent to nearly two marathons. The winner is determined by the fastest time on the last lap if multiple participants finish.

name: Oktobermila
description: The October Mile is held every year in mid to late October, and in 2025, the race will take place on Sunday, October 19, starting at 12:00 PM. Distribution of race numbers begins at 11:00 AM at Lerstad School, with the start and finish located near Lerstad Primary School. The race features distances of 5 km and 10 km, running along Lerstadvatnet and Lerstadvegen, with a flat course except for an uphill stretch of about 300 meters. Participants receive a medal upon completion, and there are prizes for the best in each distance.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a gravel road along Lerstadvatnet and on the sidewalk for the rest of the course.
Everyone who completes one of the distances will receive a medal.
The winners of the 5 km receive a trophy, and the top three in each gender category for the 10 km also receive a trophy.

name: Ekeberg Dogrun
description: The Vom Dogrun is for everyone who wants to take part in a pleasant activity with their dog. Participants can choose to compete with or without timing, and everyone is welcome to run or walk. In the competitive class, there is only one dog and one person per bib number with timing, while two dogs per person are allowed in the open class. This is a social activity for the whole family, perfect for those who want to walk, jog, or run with their dog.
course_highlights: You can choose with or without timing.
The competition class consists of only one dog and one person per bib number with timing.
In the open class, two dogs per person are allowed.

name: Lierløpet 14
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses. The race takes place on a wide pathway and is well-used by runners and fitness enthusiasts in the Drammen area. This event offers distances of 5K, 10K, and half marathon, making it accessible for both experienced runners and beginners.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway.
The race is well-utilized by runners and recreational athletes in the Drammen area.

name: Neskollen Ultra
description: Neskollen Frontyard is a unique Ultra race organized by Hvam IL Athletics, taking place on a relatively flat 3 km loop. Runners must complete the first lap within 30 minutes, with time requirements becoming stricter for each subsequent lap. This event is designed for the whole family, featuring a special competition for families where we crown the "Ultra Family" based on the number of completed laps. Participants who finish the first lap receive a medal, and rankings are determined by the number of completed laps within the time limit.
course_highlights: The runners must complete the first lap within 30 minutes, with stricter time requirements for each subsequent lap.
There is a special competition for families, where up to 4 members can participate together.
15 laps or more constitute an Ultra distance, and everyone who completes the first lap receives a medal.

name: Borredalsmila
description: Borredalsmila is an exciting race that offers varied terrain and challenging hills. The courses stretch through beautiful nature in Fredrikstadmarka, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural beauty. It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances suitable for everyone. The race has been organized since 1988, and in 2014 it became the first race to run in the opposite direction.
course_highlights: The courses stretch through beautiful nature, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural wonders.
It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances that suit everyone.
The 10 km races take place on gravel roads, and partly on mountains, in Fredrikstadmarka.

name: Bygdøymila
description: Bygdøymila is a fantastic race that takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, consisting of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel on a gently undulating course. The race was first held in the 1980s before it was discontinued, but it has been revived and organized in the last couple of years. This year, there were nearly 1500 registered participants, spread across the distances of 10 km, 6 km, 3 km, and the mini race, with the most participants in the main distance of 10 km.
course_highlights: The race takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, with a course that consists of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel.
Bygdøymila has experienced a significant resurgence and has become a very popular race in recent years.
A total of nearly 1500 participants registered, with 681 lining up for the main distance of 10 km.

name: UM/NM Terrengløp, lang løype
description: We welcome you to the Norwegian Championships in cross-country running long course at Nordbytjernet, Jessheim! The course is planned as a loop of 1.5 km that will be run several times depending on the distance. There will also be an opportunity to participate in the recreational class, where you can add a loop up Grønlivegen for a total distance of 8 km. Remember that the deadline for regular registration ends at midnight on October 3rd.
course_highlights: The course follows a developed gravel path around the idyllic Igltjønna in Rindal Center.
It will be a 1.5 km loop that will be run several times depending on the distance.
The recreational class can, if desired, add a loop up Grønlivegen to Elshaug and back via Landsem along the old Grønlivegen, resulting in a total distance of 8 km.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: The Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and has a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and offers participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The Nordhagarunden is quite demanding, and participants experience a varied course with both uphill and downhill sections. This race is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to test their limits.
course_highlights: The race is part of the Snøkuten series and gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings.
The Nordhagarunden is 9.5 kilometers long and quite challenging, with varied obstacles along the course.
Only 24 raced the Nordhagarunden for time, but there were plenty of joggers with reflectors along the course.

name: Hjerteløpet 5K
description: The Heart Run 5K was held on Thursday, October 24, in Holmenkollen by the pharmaceutical company Boehringer Ingelheim, to benefit Adults with Congenital Heart Defects (VMH) and the Organ Donation Foundation. Nearly 300 people participated in the event, where they could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo. This was the first time the race was held in Holmenkollen, and the course was steep.
course_highlights: Participants could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo.
The Heart Race 5K is a refreshing fun run that starts and finishes at the Ski Arena in Holmenkollen.
Everyone is welcome, and it's free!

name: Lommedalen Rundt
description: Lommedalen Rundt is a race on the hills around Lommedalen in Bærum, first organized in 2015. The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through forests, starting and finishing at Bærum Golf Club. There is also a separate 3 km race for children, and the 19 km distance caters to all levels of ambition. Each year, a few dozen runners complete more than 2 laps.
course_highlights: The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through the forest.
The start and finish are at Bærum Golf Club.
A separate 3 km race for children and 19 km caters to all levels of ambition.

name: Kvalheimmila - Bislett
description: Kvalheimmila is a track race where everyone is welcome to participate. The race is held at Bislett Stadium, providing you with a great opportunity for a personal best in the 5 km or 10 km. The waves are divided according to desired finish times, and all waves receive pacers to help guide you to the finish line. But remember, you still have to run!
course_highlights: Kvalheimmila is Oslo's flattest and most even fun run!
The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, also known as the world record track in international athletics.
The arena is set up with a screen for passing times, upbeat music, and drink stations to ensure a great environment for fast races.

name: Bergen Maraton
description: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km), Jæger Half Marathon (21 km), BT Relay, Oris Dental 5 km, and Vestkanten Children's Race (2 km). The course is designed to be inclusive and suitable for various skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a diverse experience for the runners. Race day starts with a group warm-up at 7:15 AM and concludes with Bryggen reopening to traffic at 4 PM. Bergen is the marathon city number 1 in Norway.
course_highlights: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km) and the Jæger Half Marathon (21 km).
The course is designed to be inclusive and adaptable to different skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a varied experience for the runners.
Race day starts with a group warm-up at 07:15 and concludes with Bryggen reopening for traffic at 16:00.

name: Lillomarka Rundt
description: Lillomarka Rundt is a 50-kilometer loop on trails in Lillomarka, featuring 2500 meters of elevation gain and technical trails with a bit of gravel. The route passes through Sinober, which is the northernmost point, and participants are advised to bring their own food due to the length. The start is at Skytta kindergarten, and the race takes you through rolling terrain, with beautiful views from heights of 400 meters above sea level.
course_highlights: The course has an elevation gain of 2500 meters and consists of technical trail with a little bit of gravel.
We start at Skytta kindergarten, and the first leg goes over to Steinbruvann.
Well arrived at Sinober, we are at about 400 meters altitude, almost at the top of Lillomarka.

name: Hinnaløpet
description: The Hinnaløpet is an annual running competition held for the 39th time in Stavanger, Rogaland. There are two course options: Hinnaløpet, a challenging loop course of 9.3 km starting from Hinna Stadium into Sørmarka, where 70% of the route is on gravel and the rest on asphalt, and "Hinnaberget 5980," a shorter and less demanding variant of 5.98 km. The courses provide participants with a unique experience of the region's beautiful natural areas, featuring stage climbs up the hills in Sørmarka.
course_highlights: The Hinnaløpet offers a challenging loop course of 9.3 km, where 70% of the route is on gravel.
"Hinnaberget 5980" is a shorter and less demanding variant of the Hinnaløpet, with the same start and finish.
The race starts at 2:00 PM at Hinna Sports Park, which is also the finish area.

name: Checkpoint Melshei
description: Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run that stands out because there is no fixed route. Participants must visit three checkpoints in Melsheia, but they choose their own path between them. You can opt to run on fast surfaces like gravel or asphalt, but that means a longer distance, or you can aim for a shorter route with rougher terrain off the trails. The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausens, creating a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day, complete with a kiosk, announcer, changing rooms, and lots of people.
course_highlights: What makes the race special is that there is no fixed course you have to follow.
Participants must pass through three locations in Melsheia, which are called checkpoints.
The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausen, so there will be a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day!

name: Checkpoint Melshei 2026
description:
Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run in Melsheia in Sandnes. The start and finish are at the SI cabin.

The course runs between three checkpoints that the runners must visit. Participants can choose their own route to the checkpoints. The checkpoints are announced in advance so that runners can plan their race.

The terrain depends on the route choice and will vary from fast surfaces like asphalt and gravel to trails and rougher terrain with varying elevation.

You can expect to run between 7 and 10 km.

Prizes for winners in each category, in addition to random draw prizes.

Kiosk and speaker at the venue. Restrooms and changing rooms at the SI cabin.
course_highlights: Checkpoint Melshei is an accessible trail run.
Participants choose their own route between three checkpoints in Melsheia.
